t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I think they are telling me not to pick randomly, but to learn which colour gnome gives the largest number of mushrooms. They are also telling me that it changes throughout the game.

vb_textbox.text: If there is a technique for picking the right one, I don't know what it is.However, I think that at any one time, there are three colours of gnome that give you the highest number of mushrooms and you should try to remember these and select them when they come up.You should also be prepared to change which three colours these are as it does seem to change throughout the game.
